description: Returns all registered validator nodes with their status, bond amounts, and operational information. Each bond provider may carry a Bond Yield configuration (bps share of rewards paid out automatically and its payout_target); the fields are absent on nodes without one. Supports pagination with limit and offset parameters.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 100, max 1000)

offset.description: Number of results to skip for pagination

name: list_nodes
